digest.component_or_area: metrics blame system and clone documentation
propositions: _blame_file_commits currently returns [] both on git failure and on successful-but-empty blame, making failure indistinguishable from legitimacy and preventing abort-on-failure logic.
When git blame fails on some paths but succeeds on others in derive_caused_by, the strict-majority culprit election runs over a partial set and can write an incorrect caused_by link.
derive_caused_by must abort and return None if any per-path blame fails, rather than tallying partial results across paths.

Clone guidance documentation must record measured performance numbers for --filter=blob:none (68.7 MiB / 14.3 s vs full 1.04 GiB / 59 s) and warn that --filter=tree:0 must never be used (3.57 GiB, 3.4x larger).
Legitimate empty-blame results (zero lines for a path) must not trigger abort, only actual git command failures should.
